bio: Randy Villegas (born November 12, 1994) is an American professor, businessman, and politician. A Democrat, he won the 2026 election for California's 22nd congressional district, which encompasses the southern Central Valley. In California's June 2026 top-two primary, he finished ahead of Democratic state assemblymember Jasmeet Bains and advanced to the general election against Republican incumbent David Valadao.
